jobs.title: Software Engineer, New Grad 2026
jobs.description:
Color is revolutionizing cancer care with the nation’s first Virtual Cancer Clinic, delivering high-quality, physician-led multidisciplinary care across all 50 states. Our innovative, guideline-based approach spans cancer screening, risk assessment, prevention, diagnosis, treatment support, and survivorship. In addition to personalized direct medical care, our services include cancer genetics risk assessment, nutrition, mental health support and at-home cancer screening diagnostics. Using technology-driven, patient-centric solutions, Color is transforming how employers, unions, health plans, and governments address cancer. Color’s goal is to close critical cancer care gaps, improve cancer outcomes, and guide patients with empathy through their healthcare journeys.

Apply to join Color and do the most meaningful work of your career. If you are not sure that you’re 100% qualified but are up for the challenge - we want you to apply!

Role Introduction:

We are excited to bring a cohort of recent software engineering graduates to our technical team of roughly 50 engineers, product managers and designers. These two engineers will join teams who are working on the AI platform that will power internal care team tools and patient experiences, and the services and experiences that enable our patients to efficiently onboard, assess risk and get the appropriate screenings.

This new grad cohort (four in total) will be onboarded to Color’s systems and thoughtfully supported by senior engineers and leads as they learn the craft of software engineering. The engineering and product team will help you build skills in engineering design, code review best practices, testing best practices, observability best practices and collaboration skills with product & engineering peers.

Sample projects the cohort will contribute to:

 - Embed AI-driven automation into care workflows to significantly increase care team capacity without sacrificing quality

 - Extend and build patient experiences across their entire journey – from onboarding & enrollment, testing & resulting, in treatment experiences to survivorship

 - Build infrastructure for developers to expand and unlock developer efficiencies and enable new AI tooling

Our Ideal Candidate Will Have:

 - Graduated in 2025 or 2026 with a four year degree in Computer Science

 - A passion for using software and technology to help save lives and prevent catastrophic disease, and want to apply your skills in the service of a greater mission

 - A commitment to producing high quality code, and helping to eliminate unnecessary duplication and awkward workarounds

 - Experience using AI tools (e.g., code generation, copilot) in development workflows.

 - Curiosity around intentionally applying ML/AI to real-world problems

 - Motivation to join a team with rigorous engineering practices and discipline: code reviews, automated testing, logging, monitoring, alerting, etc

 - Familiarity with web development and with modern web stacks including Python, Django, AWS, SQL, REST APIs, React, HTML5, CSS3, and ES6+

 - An affinity for collaborating with technical and non-technical colleagues; values incorporating feedback to make decisions using code reviews, docs, wikis, meetings, and other channels as needed

Helpful Though Not Required:

 - Experience building with or integrating LLM-powered features is a plus.


What We Offer:

 - 💰 Competitive salary

 - ✨ Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life, and disability benefits

 - 📈 401k match

 - 📝 Monthly phone and wifi stipend for employees, annual ergonomic stipend

 - 🏝 Generous vacation policy, paid holidays and company-wide recharge days

 - 🍼 Equal paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents

 - Free cancer screening and prevention resources for employees and their adult dependents

Base Salary Range:$125,000-$140,000 annually 

The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: work experience, market data, skills, geographic location, and business need. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Color prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type and affords equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Color conforms to the spirit as well as to the letter of all applicable laws and regulations. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified applicants with disabilities in our recruitment process.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Marsh logo
AI Engineer
Marsh
Dublin, County Dublin
Permanent Contract; Hybrid
Published: 3 weeks ago
€ Not Disclosed
Marsh logo
AI Engineer
Marsh
What can you expect?

Marsh is a global leader in insurance broking and risk management, serving clients in over 130 countries. The AI Center of Excellence is a newly formed team with a singular mission: get emerging AI capabilities into the hands of Marsh engineers and business teams as fast as the technology landscape moves.

We're looking for an AI Engineer who wants to live on the cutting edge of AI. You'll be the person who picks up preview-stage technologies - new LLM approaches, memory systems, agentic deployment frameworks, guardrails, Model Context Protocol (MCP) tooling - runs rapid proofs-of-concept and turns the successful ones into production-ready capabilities that the rest of Marsh can adopt.

This is an individual contributor role, but you'll become the recognised subject-matter expert in one or more AI technology areas. That means coaching your peers in the AI CoE, presenting internally, and - critically - ensuring that both human engineers and autonomous AI coding agents across the enterprise are configured to use these technologies correctly and select them ahead of alternatives.

We will count on you to:
Run focused proofs-of-concept - typically one or two at a time - to evaluate emerging AI technologies against real Marsh use cases, moving from experiment to recommendation at speed
Select and recommend technologies for adoption, producing clear guidance on when and why to use them
Productionise chosen capabilities with repeatable, infrastructure-as-code deployment patterns using Crossplane across AWS, Azure, and other hyperscaler clouds, then hand operational ownership to the appropriate platform teams
Direct AI coding agents (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, and others) - ensuring they are technically configured to leverage new technologies, select them appropriately, and follow Marsh standards
Become a subject-matter expert in one or more AI technology domains (e.g. memory and retrieval, agent orchestration, guardrails and safety, MCP tooling) and coach peers across Marsh on those topics
Engage with business units across Marsh through architecture forums, dev councils, and other channels to understand needs and feed requirements back into the PoC pipeline
Share knowledge internally through blog posts, demos, and presentations - keeping the wider engineering community informed about what's coming and what's ready
What you need to have:
Strong software engineering experience in Python and/or TypeScript, with a track record of shipping production systems - not just prototypes
Hands-on experience with AI engineering: integrating, deploying, instrumenting, and operating LLM-based systems (prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, function calling, agent frameworks, evaluation, observability)
Experience writing infrastructure-as-code for cloud deployments (Crossplane preferred; Terraform, Pulumi, or CDK experience transfers well)
Comfort working across multiple cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) rather than deep specialism in one
Strong intellectual curiosity and high standards - you actively track emerging technology, learn quickly, and care about doing excellent work
The ability to evaluate a new technology quickly and form a clear recommendation
Excellent communication skills, able to explain a complex technical decision to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders
What makes you stand out:
Breadth of programming language experience beyond Python/TypeScript - Rust, Go, or others that demonstrate curiosity and range
Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) - building or consuming MCP servers and tools
Experience with Crossplane or Kubernetes-based infrastructure management
Exposure to AI safety and guardrails frameworks (content filtering, prompt injection defence, output validation)
Experience configuring or extending AI coding assistants (custom instructions, tool integration, workspace configuration)
Background in fine-tuning or adapting foundation models
What makes this role different:
You'll use things before anyone else. Preview APIs, beta frameworks, technologies that don't have Stack Overflow answers yet.
You'll shape technical direction. Your PoC outcomes and recommendations directly influence which technologies Marsh adopts across the enterprise.
You'll onboard humans and machines. You'll ensure that AI coding agents across the organisation are configured to use the right tools in the right way.
You'll be one of the first members of the AI CoE. You'll help shape ways of working, team culture, and technical standards as the team grows.
You'll have the tools you need. Access to AI models, tools, tokens, and broader professional development opportunities.
Why join our team:
We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can collaborate with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities.
Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit or follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, Traveller community, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to providing reasonable support to any candidate with a disability/health condition to allow them to fully participate in the recruitment process. We welcome candidates to contact us at to discuss any specific needs.

Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one "anchor day" per week on which their full team will be together in person.

To be considered for this role you will be redirected to and must complete the application process on our careers page. To start the process, click the Apply button below to Login/Register.
